newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean LG-Caltex sees CDU full operation in Nov.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean LG-Caltex sees CDU full operation in Nov.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp, a unit of LG Group, expects full commercial production of its new crude distillation unit (CDU) in November, an LG-Caltex official said on Tuesday.
The new CDU has a government licensed production capacity of 220,000 barrels per day (bpd), but company officials said the unit will be capable of processing 270,000 bpd of crude oil.

"We have not set dates for the test run or commercial production," the official told Reuters. "But we are most likely to start test-running in the second-half of October and expect full production in November."
Construction of the CDU is scheduled to be completed by the middle of this month, the officials said.
The new unit will boost LG-Caltex's licensed crude processing capacity to 600,000 bpd from the current 380,000 bpd to debut as the nation's second largest refiner.
South Korea currently has a refining capability of 2.02 million bpd.
LG-Caltex is a joint venture between LG Group and Caltex Petroleum Corp, itself a joint venture between U.S. oil giants Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
